<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class EmptyHistoryClone141 {}
$source = new EmptyHistoryClone141;
$source->alpha = 7;
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "first:", $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
unset($key, $value);
unset($source->alpha);
echo "empty:";
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "bad-entry|"; }
$copy = clone $source;
echo $source !== $copy ? "fresh|" : "bad-identity|";
$copy->beta = 11;
$source->gamma = 13;
echo isset($source->beta) ? "bad-source-beta|" : "source-no-beta|";
echo isset($copy->gamma) ? "bad-copy-gamma|" : "copy-no-gamma|";
echo "source:";
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
echo "copy:";
foreach ($copy as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
echo "Z|";
